methodology: Bouritsas et al. (2026) GNN expressivity; subgraph isomorphism counting
interpretation: Systematic 3-/4-node motif counting vs hand-picked bridge/articulation features. A POSITIVE gap means systematic counting beats hand-picked (reviewer question answered: hand-picked is suboptimal). A NEGATIVE gap means hand-picked is empirically optimal on this family at n=10 — an honest result. A TIE means the two feature sets are collinear (bridge = special case of cut-edge subgraph).
